name: Kumamoto M6.8 earthquake, Japan

signal.label: Motion toward the satellite
signal.noise_method: robust scatter of differences between neighbouring measured cells; includes real gradients, so it is an upper-ish bound

line.name: the rupture
line.measured_means: the radar sees a step of 10 cm or more in ground motion within 1 km of this part of the line
line.dashed_means: the line is drawn from the field survey only: the radar has no reading, or sees less than 10 cm of step, near this part of the line
line.caveat: The line is straight segments between field-survey sites, not a trace of the break. The sites are placed by place name (location confidence in line.json), good to about 1 km. Sites located only by town name (confidence 'low') are listed but left off the line. The line is not extended beyond the surveyed sites. Where the plain gave no radar signal the line is dashed.
